name: yandex-games-debug-checker
description: Unofficial pre-submission and runtime checker for Yandex Games

scripts.test: node --check debugcheck.js && node tests/static-checks.mjs && node tests/example-static.mjs && node scripts/audit.mjs
scripts.audit: npm test && bash tests/browser-smoke.sh && bash tests/orc-castle-smoke.sh && node scripts/build-pages.mjs
